purpose: Verify a registered reconciled Rust project and, when selected, its exact published output in one owned temporary workspace.
inputs: A registered checked Rust project plan, one explicit Cargo executable, an optional exact output target and output layout, and an optional existing real temporary parent.
checks: Recheck source identity and all generated artifact hashes.
Independently inspect exact module wiring, 13-of-13 metatype accounting, selector binding, and forbidden placeholders or effects.
When a target is supplied, require the published receipt, artifact bytes and complete target shape to be current for the exact selected view.
Run dependency-free Cargo metadata and Cargo check offline with the generated lock file.
Remove exactly the verifier-owned temporary workspace on pass or failure.
claim_ceiling: Exact output currentness, native source shape and Cargo compilation for the checked generated crate; not provider behavior, deployment, publication, admission, or release.
